import os,re,collections,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Test the full rule: pick value with fewest occurrences across quadrants; tie -> quadrant with smallest noise count wins.
# Noise per quadrant = second-most-common color count? or dominant-count vs total - noise? Use noise count = H*W - count of dominant.
for n_ in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n_} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n_} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0]); H,W=h//2,w//2
    Q={'TL':lambda r,c:I[r][c],'TR':lambda r,c:I[r][c+W//2],'BL':lambda r,c:I[H+r][c],'BR':lambda r,c:I[H+r][c+W//2]}
    qnames=['TL','TR','BL','BR']
    infos={qn:(collections.Counter(Q[qn](r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)).most_common(1)[0][0],
                sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if Q[qn](r,c)!=dom)) for qn in qnames}
    pred=[]
    for r in range(H):
        row=[]
        for c in range(W):
            vals=[Q[qn](r,c) for qn in qnames]
            cc=collections.Counter(vals); mn=min(cc.values()); cand=[v for v,k in cc.items() if k==mn]
            # candidate must not equal own quadrant's noise color... unless that is the true value? Decide per-value score:
            # score = noise count of owning quad; prefer smaller; tie-break by global rank order TL,TR,BL,BR
            scored=[]
            for j,vv in enumerate(cand):
                sc=infos[qnames[j]][1]
                # exclude candidates whose value IS the owning quad's noise color? first try without exclusion
                scored.append((sc,j,vv))
            scored.sort(key=lambda s:(s[0],qnames.index(qnames[s[1]])))
            row.append(scored[0][2])
        pred.append(row)
    bad=sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if pred[r][c]!=O[r][c])
    print('demo',n_,'failures:',bad,'/',H*W)

import os,re,collections,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Rule candidate: cell-wise majority; ties -> TR reads more reliable? Check tie counts vs out per demo and whether TR wins ties.
for n_ in range(1,9):
    I_=G[f'Demo pair {n_} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n_} output']
    h,w=len(I_),len(I_[0]); H,W=h//2,w//2
    qs={'TL':lambda r,c:I_[r][c],'TR':lambda r,c:I_[r][c+w//2],'BL':lambda r,c:I_[H+r][c],'BR':lambda r,c:I_[H+r][c+w//2]}
    tl=collections.Counter(['TL','TR','BL','BR']); tr=collections.Counter(['TR','TL','BR','BL'])
    ties=sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if len({qs[qn](r,c) for qn in ['TL','TR','BL','BR']})==2 and sum(1 for qn in ['TL','TR','BL','BR'] if qs[qn](r,c)!=O[r][c])==2)
    # also: is out ever neither majority nor tiebreak? just report mismatches for "majority, else TR-valued minority partner" rules variants... do simple: out = mode; on tie, which value wins?
    vals=collections.defaultdict(list)
    mm=0
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            p=tuple(qs[qn](r,c) for qn in ['TL','TR','BL','BR'])
            cc=collections.Counter(p); ov=O[r][c]
            mx=max(cc.values())
            cand=[v for v,k in cc.items() if k==mx]
            ok=True
            for v in cand:
                if v==ov: break
            print(n_,'cell',(r,c),'vals',p,'out',ov,'mode',[v for v,k in cc.items() if k==cc[p.index(ov)] if False][0] if False else None)
            break
        break
    print('demo',n_,'done')
